candidates.statement: Checkout 502s trace to inventory's redis.reserve_inventory failing with timeout/DependencyUnavailable, propagating 503 from inventory and 502 from order to gateway checkout.
candidates.uncertainty: No redis-side metrics/logs; root cause of redis timeout (load, saturation, network) unconfirmed.

report.explanation: Traces show every failed checkout correlates with redis.reserve_inventory timeouts in inventory, cascading 503/502 upstream. Gateway metrics show elevated checkout p95 (~2387ms) and 502s. Bounded candidate is redis-timeout; redis-side evidence still needed to confirm the underlying cause.
missing_evidence: Redis server metrics/logs showing latency, saturation, or connection errors during the incident window
Inventory service logs confirming redis client timeout configuration and error rates
